en.content:
A scientific committee is to be formed from 6 Indians and 8 foreigners, which includes at
least 2 Indians and double the number of foreigners as Indians. Then the number of ways,
the committee can be formed, is :
en.explanation:
Given,

Number of Indians = 6

Number of foreigners = 8

Committee of at least 2 Indians and double number of foreigners is to be formed. Hence, the required cases are

(2I, 4F) + (3I, 6F) + (4I, 8F)

= (15 70) + (20 28) + (15 1)

= 1050 + 560 + 15 = 1625
